data.name: Absurd Quest: A Streetwear RPG
data.detailed_description:
AN IDEA HAS BEEN SPARKED!

Absurd Quest: A Streetwear RPG is an open-world, turn-based RPG inspired by the lifestyle and culture of the streetwear industry. An idea has found you, now it's up to you to bring it to life.

Bringing your idea to life won't be easy. Face rivals, haters, creative blocks, and powerful industry figures determined to crush your Passion. Use your Motivation, build your Influence, and master your Creative Class to overcome every challenge standing in your way!

CHOOSE YOUR CREATIVE CLASS:

Choose between three different Creative Classes, each inspired by elements of the streetwear world.

ARTIST: specializes in visual creativity, using Drawing, Painting, and Graphic Design.

CREATOR: excels at hands on craftsmanship, using Screen Printing, Cut-and-Sew, and Production.

VISIONARY: channels creative energy through Photography, Styling, and Innovation.

 * A DEEP DIVE INTO CREATIVE CLASSES , GAMEPLAY SYSTEMS AND MORE IS COMING SOON *

GET CREATIVE WITH A VARIETY OF UNIQUE MINI-GAMES! 

SOME MORE GAMEPLAY FEATURES:

  • FULL CHARACTER CUSTOMIZATION 

  • QUEST LINE

  • ACHIEVEMENTS

  • COLLECTABLES

  • ORIGINAL MUSIC SCORE BY @BEATSBYTICKLE

  •  + MORE (SHOWCASING SOON)

CREATED BY:  NICK HUNT AND STREETWEAR BRAND: @absurd
